name: TabStop
description: Represents a single tab stop. The TabStop object is a member of the TabStops collection. The TabStops collection represents all the tab stops on one ruler.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Represents the formatting of a tab stop. Read/write.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of the specified tab stop, in points. Read/write.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the specified tab stop from the ruler and deletes it from the TabStops collection.
